mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 215.0 (as of t-1mo) indicates persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% (as of t-1mo), it signals a labor market weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 95.0 (as of t-1mo) signals a contraction in industrial output that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a dual shock of economic weakness and monetary tightening, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and rise in FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% (as of t-1mo) signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
